next_action.summary: MIE-0017: OpenTelemetry-compatible trace projection, borrowing the GenAI semantic conventions (PA-otel-genai) with no dependency. Add `agent-os orchestrate trace <run-id> [--out file]` that converts an orchestrated run's telemetry/ledger events into OTLP/JSON spans: one workflow span per run, one span per node attempt (gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.provider.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model from model_resolved, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens, error.type on failure), and child spans for validation and review. Never export prompt or output text (privacy boundary); mark agent/workflow span conventions as provisional. Test on a synthetic run (structure, parent/child ids, attribute names, no content leakage) and document how to load the file into a local OTel backend such as Phoenix (PA-phoenix, DEFER) without adopting it.
